verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents an official Connector SDK (Python) with a public GitHub repo for building custom connectors, plus a REST API for programmatic management, and even ships AI coding agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) that add SDK-specific skills for natural-language connector development. This directly supports AI-native developers building against official, documented SDKs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality and evidence of SDKs beyond Python.
